mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 71 degrees. The moon is in its Waning Gibbous phase, and if you are up early, you can spot the space station at 4:14 AM as it travels from the northwest near the high school toward the northeast near Home Depot.

Mayor Diaz has issued two important proclamations for the month of September. September is officially Hunger Action Month to raise awareness about local food insecurity, and September 1 is dedicated as Building Inspector and Code Staff Appreciation Day to honor our local safety guardians.

There is plenty to do in town. Today, the Verona Area Kids Triathlon is taking place at the high school. Tomorrow, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness, and look forward to trivia nights starting Tuesday at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company.

During the week of August 17 to August 24, the police department handled several calls. On August 17, officers located and arrested a 21-year-old man on Cross Country Road regarding a probation violation.
Today's flavor is the delightful Crazy for Cookie Dough. Since the store is currently closed, please note that it opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
